hero.cantonHeading: Health insurance premium reduction {canton} — check eligibility and apply
hero.cantonHeadingDefault: Are you eligible for the health insurance premium reduction?
hero.cantonParagraph: The canton grants residents with modest financial means contributions toward reducing their health insurance premiums. We help you check your eligibility and submit your application correctly.

problemSection.heading: Why do many eligible people never apply for their health insurance premium reduction?
problemSection.intro: Even though thousands of people are entitled to it, many never submit an application. The most common reasons: the process looks complicated, many don't know whether they qualify, and deadlines are often missed. Yet the process is simpler than expected — as long as you know the exact requirements and deadlines.

reasons.title: Too complicated
reasons.text: The application process looks like a lot of work

reasons.title: Unsure
reasons.text: Many don't know whether they qualify

finalCta.heading: Check your eligibility now
finalCta.text: Book an initial consultation. We'll guide you from the eligibility check through to submission.

deadlineSection.heading: Don't miss your application deadline
deadlineSection.warning: ⚠️ Deadlines vary by canton and are often only offered once a year.
deadlineSection.paragraph1: Every canton sets its own deadline, and a missed application usually means losing a full year of premium subsidy. We know the exact deadlines for your canton of residence and will tell you, during your free initial consultation, by when you need to act.
deadlineSection.paragraph2: Anyone who misses the deadline loses the premium subsidy for the current year — which can amount to several hundred to several thousand francs.
